name: A.S.T.R.O AI
description: A.S.T.R.O AI is a free desktop app for chat, code and agents, powered by a team of free AI models that answer as one. Windows, Linux and macOS.
highlights: Every screen in French and Arabic: Workspace, Agent, Notes, Tasks, Reader, Model Lab, Brain and all settings
Update notes shown in your language
Windows files show the right version in Properties
Release builds ready for code signing (SignPath on Windows, notarization on macOS)
